title: Triangle Time
body:
Goal: make the turtle draw a triangle with three equal sides.

  1. Open starter.py in Thonny.
  2. The turtle already draws ONE side. Add the code for the other two sides.
  3. A triangle turns 120 degrees at each corner (3 x 120 = 360, one full turn).
  4. Press Run (F5) and watch.

Done looks like: a closed triangle - the turtle ends where it started.

Challenge: under the triangle, draw a square in a different color from the palette (move with t.penup(), t.forward(150), t.pendown() first).

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Look at the two lines the turtle already runs in starter.py. They draw one side and then turn. The # TODO comments show where the other two sides go.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Each side of the triangle is a move forward and then a turn left. Use the same two commands again for side 2 and side 3. The turn for a triangle is the number from the README, not 90.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Under each # TODO, write two lines: t.forward(____) and t.left(____). Use the same side length as the first side, so all three sides match. Run it, and check that the turtle ends where it started.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Triangle Time
# The turtle already draws ONE side of the triangle.
# TODO: add the code for the other two sides.
# Hint: a triangle turns 120 degrees at each corner.

import turtle

t = turtle.Turtle()
t.shape("turtle")
t.color("#CC79A7")
t.pensize(3)

t.forward(120)
t.left(120)

# TODO: side 2

# TODO: side 3

turtle.done()
